column2: The bus is never on time in the morning.|Travel & Commute
column4: 来たことがありません means 'has never once come on time' (experiential), overstating the habitual 'is never on time'; use いつも時間どおりに来ません.
column5: The bus is never on time in the morning.
column6: 朝のバスは時間どおりに来たことがありません。
column7: The morning bus has never once come on time.

column2: Why are you going to sell your bike?|Small Talk
column4: バイク means motorbike; English 'bike' usually means bicycle (自転車).
column5: Why are you going to sell your bike?
column6: どうしてバイクを売るつもりなんですか。
column7: Why are you going to sell your motorbike?
